title: BoqPdfRows
description: Rows read from ONE page of a tender Bill of Quantities that the deterministic table parser could not read cleanly (or a scanned page). Pure data: no action fields, no money fields (rates and amounts are never taken from a model). Every row is a proposal that the estimator reviews and can correct before anything is imported.

is_boq_table.description: True if this page contains BOQ item rows. False for cover pages, notes, collection or summary pages, or blank pages.

rows.description: The item rows on the page in reading order. Empty when is_boq_table is false. Skip brought-forward / carried-forward / page-total lines.

item_no.description: The item number exactly as printed (e.g. 2.14, A, 3.1.2). Null if none is printed.

description.description: The full item description, with wrapped lines joined into one string.

unit.description: The unit exactly as printed (m, m2, m3, nr, item, ls, kg, ...). Null for section headings.

quantity.description: The printed quantity as a number. Null for headings or when unreadable. Never estimate.

bbox.description: Bounding box of the row on the page image as [left, top, right, bottom], each a fraction 0..1 of the page width/height. Null if unsure.

confidence.description: Honest confidence that the rows are read correctly.
